# typestyles — agent reference

> CSS-in-TypeScript with typed variants, design tokens, and zero-runtime production extraction.

Full docs: https://typestyles.dev/llms.txt · MCP: https://typestyles.dev/mcp

## Install

```bash
pnpm add typestyles @typestyles/vite   # Vite + zero-runtime
# or: npm install typestyles          # runtime-only prototyping
```

## Core patterns

```ts
import { combine, createTypeStyles, cx, mergeProps } from 'typestyles';

export const { style, recipe, tokens, global } = createTypeStyles({ scopeId: 'app' });

const color = tokens.create('color', {
  primary: '#0066ff',
  surface: '#ffffff',
});

export const button = recipe('button', {
  base: {
    padding: '8px 16px',
    borderRadius: '6px',
    backgroundColor: color.primary,
    color: color.surface,
    '&:hover': { filter: 'brightness(0.9)' },
  },
  variants: {
    intent: {
      primary: { backgroundColor: color.primary },
      ghost: { backgroundColor: 'transparent', color: color.primary },
    },
  },
  defaultVariants: { intent: 'primary' },
});

// Usage: button({ intent: 'ghost' }) → class string
```

## Key APIs

- `createTypeStyles({ scopeId, mode?, prefix?, layers? })` — preferred entry; flat `{ style, recipe, tokens, global, … }`
- `recipe(namespace, config)` — CVA-style variants (`base`, `variants`, `defaultVariants`, `compoundVariants`)
- `style(name, properties)` — single named class
- `hash(properties)` — deterministic hashed class
- `tokens.create(namespace, values)` — CSS custom properties (`--{scopeId}-…`)
- `tokens.createTheme({ name, tokens, … })` — theme class overrides
- `global.rule` / `global.rules` / `global.apply` / `global.fontFace` — globals (not component-scoped)
- `cx(...classes)` — join class names (handles falsy values); warns in dev on attribute-mode recipe results
- `mergeProps(result, ...classNames)` — spread recipe attrs + merged `className` (attribute mode default binding)
- `combine(...parts)` — merge multiple recipe slots onto one element (class union + compatible attrs)
- `compose(...fns)` — compose style functions
- Nested layers: `layers: { order, token, style, global? }`

Lower-level: `createStyles` / `createTokens` / `createGlobal` (no root `styles` / `tokens` / `global` singletons).

Detailed API: https://typestyles.dev/docs/api-reference.md

## Zero-runtime

1. Add bundler plugin (`@typestyles/vite`, `@typestyles/next`, …)
2. Create `typestyles-entry.ts` importing all style modules
3. `vite build` emits static `typestyles.css` — no client runtime

Guide: https://typestyles.dev/docs/zero-runtime.md

## Common mistakes

- **Missing side-effect entry** — build extraction only sees imported style modules
- **Unscoped `style` / `recipe`** in libraries — use `createTypeStyles({ scopeId: 'pkg' })` per package
- **Dynamic class strings** — use variants or `hash`, not template literals for one-off classes
- **Forgetting `scopeId`** when multiple bundles share a page — token/class collisions
- **SSR without server helpers** — import from `typestyles/server` for streaming/collection
- **Importing removed singletons** — `import { styles }` / `import { tokens }` / `import { global }` from `typestyles` no longer exist

## Subpath exports

| Import | Use |
| ------ | --- |
| `typestyles` | Core runtime |
| `typestyles/server` | SSR (`collectStyles`, …) |
| `typestyles/build` | Build stubs when runtime disabled |
| `typestyles/color` | Color helpers (off main bundle) |
| `typestyles/testing` | Test-state reset (`resetAll`, `onAfterReset`, `createTestHarness`) |
